summary: Retested the new 'landing screen first' UX (home -> today's revision, library, upload, progress tiles), the J-method spaced-repetition system (daily deck, stage badges, server-side level progression/reset, 7-day plan chart, per-user isolation), and card reporting. Extended the existing browser-check and backend-test suites in place (did not rewrite). 5 new backend test files (9 tests) + 7 new browser checks + 6 pre-existing browser checks updated to navigate through the new landing page before reaching the library (non-regression, since /cours is no longer the default landing route) + 1 extra run of the landing check against the public preview URL. All checks pass after fixes.

checks.evidence: action-browse-library -> URL '/cours' with sheet-search-input visible; back-to-today-link -> '/' with tiles visible; re-entered '/cours', header-home-link -> '/' with tiles visible again.

action_items: None blocking. Note: quiz-long-options-desktop-full-flow's first rerun after the navigation update hit a one-off Playwright 'element not attached to DOM' error while scrolling into view during a card-exit animation; replaced scrollIntoViewIfNeeded with a toBeVisible wait and it now passes on two consecutive reruns — classified as test flakiness from the animation timing, not an app bug.
notes: 8 acceptance_matrix criteria all covered: 1,2,3,6 have UI browser checks (3,6 also have backend coverage since API-backed); 4,5,7 are pure/mostly API criteria covered by backend tests (5 also has a UI browser check for the chart); 8 (non-regression) is covered by rerunning/updating the 7 pre-existing browser checks plus the pre-existing backend regression test, since the new landing page changed the navigation path into the library that those checks depend on.
13 browser checks + 6 backend test files now in the suite (1 extra browser check run against the public preview URL as required).
No application code was modified — only /app/.emergent/scripts/checks/*.mjs (new + updated navigation), /app/backend/tests/test_tscheck_*.py (new), and this report.

Console errors observed across all checks were exclusively the expected 401 on /api/auth/me before login / after logout, matching the acceptance matrix's stated exception — no unexpected 4xx/5xx observed anywhere.
